## Event

## Before the event — Event Coordinator

- [ ] Go through the event checklist.
- [ ] Check how live code or demos can be run, if needed.
- [ ] Ask the host whether speakers should use their own laptops or send their
      slides beforehand.
- [ ] Ask the host whether the doors or gates stay open throughout the event
      and what time people can arrive at the latest.
- [ ] Ask every speaker whether they can use their own laptop.
- [ ] Ask every speaker whether they will run code or a live demo.
- [ ] Remind the speakers about the event around one week or a few days
      beforehand.
- [ ] Announce the event in X, Y, and Z, N days before the event.
- [ ] Coordinate with the MC about a laptop for the introduction.
- [ ] Coordinate with the Quiz Master / Entertainer about a laptop for the
      interactive activity.

## Before the event — MC

- [ ] Update the introduction slides.
- [ ] Add upcoming events to the slides.
- [ ] Arrange a laptop for the introduction and coordinate with the Event
      Coordinator.
- [ ] Have the **5 MIN**, **1 MIN**, and **NOW** cards available on a phone.

## At the event — MC

- [ ] Give the introduction.
- [ ] Introduce the speakers and handle transitions.
- [ ] Show the **5 MIN**, **1 MIN**, and **NOW** cards during talks, or delegate
      this to someone else.

## Before the event — Quiz Master / Entertainer

- [ ] Prepare the quiz or questionnaire questions.
- [ ] Test the questionnaire beforehand.
- [ ] Make sure a laptop is available for the questionnaire and coordinate
      with the Event Coordinator.

## At the event — Quiz Master / Entertainer

- [ ] Run the planned quiz, questionnaire, or other interactive activity.

## Venue visit — owner to be decided

- [ ] Decide whether the Event Coordinator or MC visits the venue before event
      day.
- [ ] Visit the venue before event day.
- [ ] Test how laptops connect to the venue AV system.
- [ ] Record any other technical requirements:
